When approached for comment, Marion Jessie Thompson remained tight-lipped about the details of her marriage, citing "personal reasons" for her reluctance to discuss the matter further. "I'm just grateful to have found love, no matter the circumstances," Thompson said, her voice trembling with emotion. "Ruby has been my rock, my partner, and my best friend.
